description: Reverse-lookup a Hyperliquid open position from share-card details (symbol + side + leverage + entry price). Given the info shown on a HL trader's share card, return wallet(s) with matching open positions, ranked by entry-price proximity. Useful for 'whose share card is this?' or 'who has a 25x ETH long open at $3,200?'. Walks tight (±0.05%) -> loose (±0.5%) -> fallback (±1.0%) entry bands and requires leverage within ±0.5. Reads from the latest position snapshot (freshness-gated to the newest 15-minute window).

leverage.description: Leverage from share card (e.g. 5, 10, 25); 0 finds positions with no leverage recorded

mark_price.description: Optional current mark price; sharpens the tie-break when multiple wallets share the same entry.

name: hl_position_match
title: Hyperliquid Position Match
